# Learn Prompting (O'zbekcha)

> Learn Prompting is a free, open-source course teaching how to communicate effectively with AI systems (prompt engineering). This is the Uzbek-language ("O'zbekcha nashr") edition, maintained by HumblebeeAI, adapted from the original English project at learnprompting.org. Content covers everything from prompting basics to advanced techniques, image prompting, prompt hacking/security, and reliability methods.

## Docs: Basics
- [Kirish (Intro)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intro): Course introduction and starting point.
- [Prompt Engineering asoslari](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/prompt_engineering): What prompt engineering is and why it matters.
- [Promptlash (Prompting)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/prompting): Core prompting concepts.
- [Ko'rsatmalar (Instructions)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/instructions): Writing effective instructions for LLMs.
- [Rollar (Roles)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/roles): Using role prompting.
- [Chatbot asoslari](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basics/chatbot_basics): Basics of chatbot interaction design.

## Docs: Intermediate Techniques
- [Chain-of-Thought](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/chain_of_thought): Step-by-step reasoning prompts.
- [Zero-Shot CoT](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/zero_shot_cot): Zero-shot chain-of-thought prompting.
- [Least-to-Most Prompting](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/least_to_most): Decomposing complex problems.
- [Self-Consistency](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/self_consistency): Improving answer reliability via sampling.
- [Generated Knowledge](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/intermediate/generated_knowledge): Generating context before answering.

## Docs: Advanced Applications
- [Umumiy ko'rinish (Overview)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/advanced_applications/overview): Advanced prompting application patterns.
- [ReAct](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/advanced_applications/react): Reasoning + acting agent pattern.
- [MRKL](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/advanced_applications/mrkl): Modular reasoning and tool use.
- [PAL](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/advanced_applications/pal): Program-aided language models.

## Docs: Applied Prompting
- [Umumiy ko'rinish](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/applied_prompting/overview): Applied, real-world prompting projects.
- [ChatGPT yasash](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/applied_prompting/build_chatgpt): Building a ChatGPT-like assistant.
- [Bilim bazasidan chatbot yasash](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/applied_prompting/build_chatbot_from_kb): Building a knowledge-base chatbot.

## Docs: Basic Applications
- [Kirish (Introduction)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/introduction): Everyday practical use cases for prompting.
- [Kod yozishda yordam](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/coding_assistance): Using AI for coding assistance.
- [Xulosalash (Summarize)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/summarize): Summarization prompts.
- [Email yozish](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/basic_applications/writing_emails): Writing emails with AI.

## Docs: Image Prompting
- [Kirish (Intro)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/intro): Basics of prompting image generation models.
- [Midjourney](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/midjourney): Midjourney-specific prompting techniques.
- [Shot Type](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/shot_type): Controlling camera framing in prompts.
- [Style Modifiers](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/image_prompting/style_modifiers): Adjusting visual style via prompts.

## Docs: Prompt Hacking & Security
- [Kirish (Intro)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/intro): Overview of prompt hacking / adversarial prompting.
- [Prompt Injection](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/injection): Prompt injection attacks.
- [Jailbreaking](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/jailbreaking): LLM jailbreak techniques.
- [Prompt Leaking](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/leaking): Extracting hidden system prompts.
- [Himoya choralari (Defensive Measures)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/prompt_hacking/defensive_measures): Defending against prompt attacks.

## Docs: Reliability
- [Kirish (Intro)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/intro): Improving the reliability of LLM outputs.
- [Kalibratsiya (Calibration)](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/calibration): Calibrating model confidence.
- [Debiasing](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/debiasing): Reducing bias in model outputs.
- [Ensembling](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/reliability/ensembling): Combining multiple prompts/outputs.

## Docs: Tooling & Trainable Prompts
- [IDEs](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/tooling/IDEs): Prompting tools and IDE integrations.
- [Discretized Prompting](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/trainable/discretized): Discrete trainable prompt tokens.
- [Soft Prompting](https://learnprompting.uz/docs/trainable/soft_prompting): Continuous/soft trainable prompts.
